info.wetter-metriken.route: You can skip this — default: the weather metrics preselected by the system.
info.wetter-metriken.vergleich: You can skip this — default: the metrics preselected by the system, plus hourly forecast and 3-day outlook (both on).
info.wertebereiche.route: You can skip this — default: no target ranges, nothing is highlighted in the briefing.
info.wertebereiche.vergleich: You can skip this — default: the target ranges are prefilled from the activity profile.
info.alarme.route: You can skip this — default: alerts by email and Telegram, urgency threshold “low”, official warnings off. Telegram only takes effect once it is linked.
info.alarme.vergleich: You can skip this — default: alerts by email and Telegram, urgency threshold “low”, official warnings off. Telegram only takes effect once it is linked.
info.versand.route: You can skip this — default: email, morning briefing at 07:00 and evening briefing at 18:00.
info.versand.vergleich: You can skip this — default: email, morning briefing at 07:00, no end date.
info.wegpunkte.route: You can skip this — default: no additional waypoints.
tip.wertebereiche: A target range defines which values of a metric count as suitable. Values within the range are highlighted in the briefing.
tip.kanal_schwelle: The urgency threshold defines per channel from which level (low, medium, high) a message is sent through this channel.
tip.cape: CAPE (thunderstorm energy) measures in J/kg how much energy for thunderstorms is in the air. The threshold is a guide value and is converted per weather model and area.
tip.cooldown: The cooldown is the minimum interval in minutes between two messages for the same metric.
telegram_kurzstil.hinweis_aktiv: Telegram gets the same short one-line text as SMS, without buttons. Content and values follow the SMS selection in the Layout tab; the Telegram selection only applies to the detailed Telegram message.
telegram_kurzstil.hinweis_inaktiv: Only active when Telegram is switched on as a channel.
bausteine.alarme.leer: No threshold exceeded. You will be notified as soon as a condition changes.
bausteine.kontext.trip_text: Briefing columns per stage · horizons TODAY / TOMORROW / DAY AFTER TOMORROW selectable per metric.
bausteine.kontext.ort_text: Briefing columns per location · no horizons · a metric can count towards the score.
bausteine.kontext.abo_text: Columns per entry in the subscription comparison · no horizons · score contribution configurable per metric.
bausteine.profil.vorlage_hinweis: Choose a template or create a custom profile.
bausteine.profil.auswahl_sichern: Save the current selection ({anzahl} metrics) as a profile.
